villager_1.who: A young village woman in a simple ankle-length dress of faded blue with a cream apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, brown hair tied back in a short tail, brown shoes. Cheerful and ordinary — she is one of the townsfolk, not an adventurer.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at her sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly and let one hand rest on her hip
walk: mid-stride with her LEFT leg forward and her right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with her RIGHT leg forward and her left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

villager_2.who: A stocky village man in a loose russet-brown tunic belted at the waist, dark green trousers, sturdy boots, and a short beard under a flat brown cap. Friendly and weathered — a townsman, not a soldier.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly and folded his arms loosely
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

villager_3.who: An older village woman in a long moss-green skirt and a cream blouse with a rust-red shawl over her shoulders, grey hair in a bun, a simple headscarf. Kindly and unhurried — a townswoman.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, hands clasped in front of her
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly and let her hands fall to her sides
walk: mid-stride with her LEFT leg forward and her right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with her RIGHT leg forward and her left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

villager_4.who: A lanky young village man in a cream linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, brown breeches and worn boots, sandy hair falling over his forehead. Eager and a bit gangly — a townsman.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly and scratched the back of his neck
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest

farmer.who: A sturdy farmhand in a cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown leather apron, olive trousers and muddy boots, a straw hat pushed back off his forehead. He carries a long-handled hoe.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the hoe resting upright in one hand
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
action: standing over the ground with the hoe raised high behind him, both hands on the shaft, about to strike
mid-swing, the hoe coming down in front of him, his body bending forward into it
the blade in the soil at his feet, his back bent and his knees slightly flexed at the end of the stroke

woodcutter.who: A broad-shouldered woodcutter in a red-brown checked shirt with the sleeves cut off, a thick leather belt, dark green trousers and heavy boots, a short dark beard. He carries a felling axe.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the axe head resting on the ground beside him
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
action: the axe raised high over his shoulder in both hands, his body coiled and turned slightly away, about to swing
mid-swing, the axe sweeping down and across in front of him
the axe buried low in front of him, his body bent forward and his arms extended at the end of the stroke

quarryman.who: A wiry quarryman in a grey sleeveless tunic white with stone dust, a leather harness over one shoulder, patched brown trousers and scuffed boots, a cloth tied over his hair. He carries a pickaxe.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the pickaxe over one shoulder
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly
walk: mid-stride with his LEFT leg forward and his right arm forward
passing pose, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
mid-stride with his RIGHT leg forward and his left arm forward
passing pose again, both legs nearly together, body at its highest
action: the pickaxe raised high behind his head in both hands, his body leaning back, about to strike
mid-swing, the pick arcing down in front of him
the pick struck into the rock in front of him, his body bent forward and his arms straight at the end of the stroke

stonemason.who: A calm stonemason in a pale grey tunic and a long canvas apron dusted white, leather bracers on both forearms, brown trousers and flat shoes, hair tied back. She works with a mallet and a chisel.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the mallet held loosely at her side
the same stance a moment later, having shifted her weight slightly
action: leaning over a low block of stone, the chisel held against it in one hand and the mallet raised in the other, about to strike
the mallet coming down onto the chisel head, her shoulders dropping into the blow
the mallet resting on the chisel, her head tilted to look along the cut she has made

smith.who: A powerful smith in a soot-dark sleeveless tunic and a heavy brown leather apron, thick gloves, dark trousers and iron-shod boots, sweat-damp hair pushed back. He works with a hammer and tongs.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the hammer held head-down at his side
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly
action: leaning over a low anvil, the tongs gripping a glowing bar on it in one hand and the hammer raised high in the other
the hammer swinging down towards the bar, his shoulder dropping into it
the hammer struck on the bar, a few small sparks at the point of contact, his arm extended

carpenter.who: A broad carpenter in a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled past the elbow, a tan leather tool apron with a pocket of chisels across the front, brown trousers and flat work shoes, dark hair cut short and a pencil behind one ear. He works with a hand saw and a plane at a low trestle bench of pale timber.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the hand saw hanging from one hand at his side
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly and wiped his forehead with the back of his wrist
action: leaning over the low trestle bench, both hands on the saw, the blade set at the near end of a pale plank and his shoulders drawn back to start the cut
mid-stroke, the saw driven forward along the plank, his body leaning into it and a few curls of sawdust falling
the saw at the far end of its stroke, his arms extended and his head tilted to look along the cut

rune_carver.who: A lean rune carver in a deep indigo robe with the sleeves bound back at the forearms, a slate-grey leather apron, dark trousers and soft boots, close-cropped grey hair and a short beard. He works with a fine chisel and a small mallet on a waist-high block of pale cut stone, and the marks he cuts glow a soft cyan.

idle: standing still, weight on both feet, the mallet held loosely at his side and the chisel in his other hand
the same stance a moment later, having shifted his weight slightly and raised the chisel to inspect its tip
action: leaning over the block of pale stone, the chisel set against a half-cut rune in one hand and the mallet raised in the other, about to strike
the mallet coming down onto the chisel head, his shoulders dropping into the blow, the cut rune flaring soft cyan at the point of contact
the mallet resting on the chisel, his head tilted to look along the finished rune, which glows a steady soft cyan in the stone

fisher_boat.subject: BOAT
fisher_boat.baseline: every frame's HULL rests at the same height on the same invisible horizontal waterline across the image.
fisher_boat.who: A small open fishing boat of warm honey-brown timber with a pale cream stripe along its top plank, a coil of rope at the bow and a folded net of ochre cord heaped at the stern. A fisherman stands in it: a wiry man in a faded blue smock with the sleeves pushed up, ochre trousers rolled to the calf, bare feet, and a soft red cap. Boat and fisherman are ONE subject and are always drawn together.

idle: the boat sitting level and still, the fisherman standing upright amidships with an oar held vertically in one hand
the same, a moment later, the boat having settled slightly and the fisherman shifted his weight, the oar still upright
walk: the boat under way, the fisherman leaning forward with both hands on the oar and the blade reaching far out ahead of him, about to bite the water
the boat level and moving, the fisherman upright and the oar vertical mid-stroke, the hull at the top of its bob
the fisherman leaning back, both arms drawn in and the oar blade sweeping past behind him at the end of the pull
the boat level again, the fisherman upright and the oar vertical on the recovery, the hull at the top of its bob
action: the boat still, the fisherman leaning far over the near gunwale with both hands gripping the ochre net just at the waterline, about to haul
mid-haul, the net rising out of the water in both his hands with two or three silver fish caught in it, his back straightening
the net lifted clear and swung inboard over the stern, the fish spilling into the bottom of the boat, the fisherman upright again
